notes.title: Argol II - Curse of Nemesis - New game in development
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43320290/cd62f8e3e4925b2936c7132ee826dc09542951c3.jpg[/img]

The young warrior must this time face [b]Nemesis[/b] the goddess of vengeance. Our hero will be accompanied by [b]Evandra [/b]the Amazon and [b]Hyperion[/b] the demigod. Three playable characters that can be interchanged at any time. New features, a map to visualize your progress and choose the order in which you want to explore the different areas, adventure, more levels, more bosses, shoot 'em up phases and many surprises.

More information on the store page. Add this game to your [b]wishlist[/b] and [b]follow [/b]this page to know all the next news:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3568530/Argol_II__Curse_of_Nemesis/]store.steampowered.com/app/3568530/Argol_II__Curse_of_Nemesis/[/url]

notes.title: Adding new features
notes.notes:
As nothing is more important to us than taking into consideration the expectations of players, we have developed new features taking into account your suggestions, in order to make your gaming experience even more satisfying.

[list]
[*] [b]Dash to the left:[/b] left bumper button.
[*] [b]Dash to the right:[/b] right bumper button.
[*] [b]Lowering the camera:[/b] right stick down, or right arrow + A button.
[*] [b]Smooth camera:[/b] can be activated or deactivated in the Options menu.
[*] [b]Integration of a summary screen of your achievements[/b]: accessible from the main screen.
[*] [b]3 Speedrun trophies:[/b] depending on the difficulty level.
[*] [b]Viewing game time per level:[/b] in the level selection screen, using the X button.
[/list]
